_**User**_

sorry, the issue is that the text is hyphenated, as in the scresnshot. I want to change the css style for grid-item so that it does not get hyphenated 

---

_**Assistant**_

Ah, I understand now! You'll need to modify the CSS for the grid-item elements to prevent text hyphenation. Here's how you can do it:

```css:assets/css/custom.css
// ... existing code ...

.grid-item {
    hyphens: none;
    -webkit-hyphens: none;
    -moz-hyphens: none;
    -ms-hyphens: none;
}

// ... existing code ...
```

This CSS will disable hyphenation across all browsers. The multiple vendor prefixes (-webkit, -moz, -ms) ensure compatibility with different browsers. Add this to your custom CSS file, and the text in your grid items should no longer hyphenate like "oth-er" and "signal-ing" as shown in your screenshot.

If you don't already have a custom CSS file set up, you'll need to create one and make sure it's being loaded by your Hugo theme. Let me know if you need help with that part!
